title: Independent verification: exact F3 signed connector minimum is thirteen
body:
Ross Richardson's PR944 proves a fourteen-query minimum for 288 signed 3-by-3 connector patterns in characteristic zero and explicitly excludes finite characteristic. This independent implementation checks that boundary over **F3**: every one of the 288 patterns has exact minimum **thirteen**, with each of the six operators able to carry the extra call. For positive complete-query prices equal between signs, the exact optimum is `2 sum_F c_F + min_F c_F`.

**Status: independent verification and finite-characteristic construction; no new kappa or physical supplier.** The source interface remains fixed with read-only sources and arbitrary dirty scratch. A written complete reduction covers all twelve- and thirteen-query possibilities. The replay checks 720 six-step paths, 5,040 seven-step paths, the full 19,683-matrix classification, 1,728 literal query words and inverses, twelve noncommutative recursive leaf words, and 170 negative controls. The retained factor-length fixture uses 304 leaf calls rather than the characteristic-zero repair's 308; this compares abstract invoices in different fields, not runtime.

Only `research/ternary-connector-independent-seed84/` is added. Start with its README and certificate. Base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; OS assignment seed 84, independent-verification track. SOURCES.json pins five live inputs, three historical context blobs, and predecessor heads.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/ternary-connector-independent-seed84/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_TERNARY_CONNECTOR_INDEPENDENT matrices=19683 obstructed_minimum=13 orbit_replays=1728 source_paths=5760 leaf_replays=12 controls=170`.

Local checks pass on CPython 3.14.8 and optimized 3.11.15, including read-only relocation, deterministic replay, receipt/source corruption, exact base-blob checks, and the unchanged PR944 verifier. Selected source bindings remain unchanged. Full selected cold replay, physical/native admission, Lean, hosted-CI success and independent human review are not claimed.

Final overlap search at 2026-10-13 23:13:49 UTC covered 831 open PRs, 76 discussion records and 326 local records. Concurrent PR1340 concerns temporarily mutable F2 sources; this F3 result uses the original read-only interface. No pinned coordination issue exists, so the claim is local.

Credit Ross Richardson / PR944 and PR934, @martinxxx9 / PR1088's six-operator weighted repair, CubeJerry / PR889, Chafik Boukhalfa / PR628, and the retained framework. Prepared by Sagar Thakrar (@thakrarsagar) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New material is Apache-2.0. Review should focus on completeness of the thirteen-query reduction and the field-specific cost statement.
